### Summary

Vendor catalogue (add food, add product, saved screen), order status sheet and order list refinements, shared peach backdrop behind every screen.

### User-Facing Changes

- Every screen now has the soft peach corner background, drawn once by each app's root layout through the new Backdrop component.
- New shop screens: Catalogue for products and food (Products | Food lists, published switch, add forms), with photo upload.
- Add food in two steps with prep time, delivery options, availability and sold-out toggle; item saved confirmation screen after a successful create.
- Add product form with photo upload, redirecting to the saved screen on success.
- Orders: status filters and order details (update delivery status via a re-openable sheet, mark cash on delivery as paid); filter re-applies when re-entering from Home.

### Bug Fixes

- No bug fixes in this release.

### Security, Privacy, and Compliance

- No security, privacy, or compliance changes. Visual and feature changes only; no new permissions, data collection or network calls.

- App name changed: `No`

### Testing Scope

- Set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` (the `/api/v2` root) and `EXPO_PUBLIC_SYSTEM_KEY`, log in as a seller, and walk every vendor screen against a staging backend; none of it has been run on a device yet.
- Add food: two-step form, photo upload, save, saved screen, add another.
- Add product: form, photo upload, save, saved screen.
- Orders: update delivery status, mark cash on delivery as paid, re-open status sheet, filter persistence.
- Sign-in, forgot-password and reset-password screens in light and dark theme.
- Confirm the soft peach corner background shows through on every screen in both themes.

### Known Issues

- Needs backend changes before it works end to end: photo upload ids on create, product id in create responses, shop business category, list filters, and an `approved` flag in the product list. See stuqet-docs/audits/vendor-create-product-api-audit.md.
- Home shows only the product layout until the shop type is exposed. Support tickets and messages are not in the app yet.
- Google and Apple sign-in are not functional yet; the buttons only show a "coming soon" message.
- Google and Apple buttons use the Ionicons glyphs, not the official brand artwork.

### Rollback Notes

- Previous stable release: v1.0.0-b1-20261120.
- Rollback instructions: revert the backdrop and catalogue PRs; no data or API migration is involved.
